title: RSFA End Forms Engine: Masterboard documents request (masterboard.v1)
description: Body of POST /v1/masterboard/documents (docs/07). 'data' is Make's existing 'result' object for one Masterboard item (keys are Monday column titles). Max body 1 MiB.

correlationId.description: Unique per Make execution, e.g. mb-<boardId>-<itemId>-<executionId>. Echoed in X-Correlation-Id and logs.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable per business request (same item + same trigger event), e.g. <itemId>-<status change timestamp>. Make uses it to de-duplicate filing and Monday updates.

today.description: Date the run was requested (Pacific/Auckland). Pinned so retries across midnight give identical documents.

banks.description: Labels of the 'Selected Banks' dropdown (dropdown_mkzvfgeg), split on ', '.

includePdf.description: false = validate and return metadata/SHA-256 only (dry run).

includeCandidates.description: Bank selection: also generate 'candidate' forms (testing only).

data.description: Make 'result' object: text columns as strings or null, checkboxes as booleans, dates DDMMYYYY. Keys are normalised by the engine ('/' and '.' -> '_').
